audit.title: Audit trail
audit.subtitle: Every action is timestamped and hash-chained. Nothing can be erased.
audit.explainer: Each entry contains the fingerprint of the previous one: altering or deleting a row breaks the chain and becomes immediately detectable. The log is append-only — even an administrator cannot rewrite it.

audit.emptyBody: It fills itself: every upload, access and read leaves a chained fingerprint here.

tips.dashboard: An overview of your activity: active deals, tasks to handle and the team's latest actions.
tips.pipeline: Your deals arranged by stage, from sourcing to closing. Drag a card to move it forward.
tips.stage: The deal's stage in your investment process: Sourcing, Screening, Due diligence, Committee, Signed, Passed.
tips.deal: The dossier sheet: amount, completeness, milestones, team, internal notes and history.
tips.dataRoom: The deal's document space: folders, files, versions and access rights, all traced.
tips.viewer: Read documents page by page, watermarked on the fly. The source file never leaves the server.
tips.watermark: The watermark (viewer's email + date) is baked into the page image: impossible to remove, it deters leaks.
tips.downloadBlocked: Depending on the access level, downloading the original file is blocked — only watermarked reading is allowed.
tips.permissions: Who accesses what, folder by folder. Closed by default, inherited from parent folders, with optional expiry.
tips.permLevels: From most restricted to broadest: None, Watermarked, View, Download, Edit.
tips.invitations: Bring an external investor in, under NDA, with limited rights and an expiry date.
tips.nda: A confidentiality agreement e-signed before any access. Its signing is timestamped and logged as proof.
tips.ndaProof: Proof of signature: identity, date, IP address and a fingerprint of the signed text — enforceable in a dispute.
tips.versions: Each document's version history. Every upload creates a new version without overwriting the previous one.
tips.audit: A tamper-proof log of every action. Each entry is timestamped and hash-chained to the previous one.
tips.auditChain: Entries are linked by hash: altering or deleting a line would break the chain, which is detectable.
tips.checklist: The documents an investor will require. Attaching the document that proves an item validates it and raises completeness.
tips.readiness: Share of expected documents provided. The higher it is, the more complete the dossier.
tips.qa: Investors' questions and your answers. An answer is only visible once published.
tips.security: Protect your account: two-factor authentication and password policy.
tips.twoFactor: A second code, on top of your password, at every sign-in — via an authenticator app.
tips.roadmap: What's left to build, and when. Your testers can suggest and vote on features.
tips.sheetMode: Spreadsheets are read as a grid rather than rendered as an image, so a financial model stays readable and scrollable. Only values are sent — never formulas, nor the file itself.

cohorts.emptyFoot: You will be able to run several in parallel, and a company can belong to two cohorts.
cohorts.membersEmptyFoot: An invitation stays valid for 30 days and is re-sent in one click.
cohorts.threadsEmptyFoot: Your exchanges are visible only to the company concerned. Other cohort members know nothing of them.
cohorts.nothingListableBody: You choose who appears, company by company. Two conditions: the company has agreed to be listed, and its file is started — an investor who opens an empty profile does not come back.

showcase.title: {programme} showcase
showcase.guest: You are viewing as an invited investor
showcase.filters: {n, plural, =0 {no active filter} =1 {1 active filter} other {# active filters}} · {r, plural, =1 {1 result} other {# results}}
showcase.emptyBody: Widen your filters: the cohort may hold files that interest you outside these criteria.
showcase.noAccessTitle: This showcase is not open to you
showcase.noAccessBody: Showcase access is by named invitation from the programme. Ask them for a link.
showcase.figuresBy: Figures provided by the company · updated {date}
showcase.stale: These figures are more than three months old.
showcase.noDocs: No document can be opened from this profile.
showcase.requestAccess: Request access to the data room
showcase.requestSent: Request sent. The programme will pass it to the company.
showcase.joinInvalidTitle: This invitation is no longer valid
showcase.joinInvalidBody: The link is unknown, or access was withdrawn by the programme. Ask them for a new invitation.
showcase.joinWrongAddressTitle: This invitation is for another address
showcase.joinWrongAddressBody: You are signed in as {email}. The invitation was sent to a different address, and it is not transferable — that is what assures the programme it knows who is viewing its showcase.

requests.title: Access requests
requests.intro: You filter and recommend. The company grants — unless it has explicitly mandated you.
requests.age: {n, plural, =0 {less than a day ago} =1 {1 day ago} other {# days ago}}
requests.legend: The company will decide — you inform its decision.
requests.footer: Every outcome is written to the company's audit log. A refusal is kept.
requests.emptyBody: As soon as an investor opens a profile in your dealroom and wants to go further, their request lands in this queue — who they are, what they seek, and which room they target.
requests.emptyFoot: You filter and recommend: forward with a favourable opinion, forward without one, or dismiss. The company grants access — you inform its decision.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: A cohort statement for your funder. Aggregated figures, no documents.
reports.refusedBody: A cohort report needs at least one company with a started file. We would rather refuse to generate it than hand you a document full of blanks.
reports.refusedWhy: What will go into it: companies, amounts sought, readiness, missing documents by category, invitations and access granted over the period.
reports.noCohortBody: Create a cohort and invite companies into it: the report builds itself from their files.
reports.trendMissingBody: A funder reads curves, not a snapshot. Monthly history requires a scheduled job, which does not exist on this installation yet — so the report only shows today's state.
